slides.html:
Key one · Credit

A mortgage credit report is more than a score.

01

Score

A prediction based on information in your credit reports.

02

History

How accounts and payments have been handled over time.

03

Balances

What is owed and how much available credit is being used.

04

Activity

New applications, inquiries, collections, and public records.

Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX
slides.speakerNotes:
Walk through the four parts. A mortgage score may differ from a consumer app because different scoring models and report data can be used. Avoid promising a score requirement before reviewing the actual program and lender.

Humor line: Your free app score and your mortgage score can be like two bathroom scales—same person, suspiciously different answer.

[Sources]
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/what-is-a-credit-report-en-309/
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/what-is-a-credit-score-en-315/
[/Sources]
slides.title: A mortgage credit report is more than a score.

slides.html:
Key one · Credit

Five habits help before you apply.

  • +Pay every bill on time.
  • +Keep revolving-card balances as low as practical.
  • +Avoid opening accounts you do not need.
  • +Review all three credit reports for accurate information.
  • +Call your lender before moving money or changing debt.
Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX
slides.speakerNotes:
Make this practical. Buyers can review reports through the federally authorized source, AnnualCreditReport.com. Encourage disputes only for information that is truly inaccurate and explain that updates can take time.

Humor line: The week before closing is not the time to finance a bass boat, a sectional, or—somehow—the bass boat sitting on the sectional.

[Sources]
- https://www.annualcreditreport.com/
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/how-do-i-get-a-copy-of-my-credit-reports-en-5/
[/Sources]
slides.title: Five habits help before you apply.

Key two · Loan choice

Four program families cover many first-home scenarios.

Tap a program to see what makes it different.

Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX

General guidelines only. Actual eligibility depends on full underwriting, credit, property, and lender overlays.
slides.speakerNotes:
Introduce the major program families as starting points, not promises. Exact eligibility, pricing, mortgage insurance, occupancy, and property rules vary.

For VA, eligibility generally begins with qualifying service and a Certificate of Eligibility. USDA depends on household income and property location.

slides.title: Four program families cover many first-home scenarios.

slides.html:
Key two · Loan choice

Low down payment

  • Some conventional options begin at 3% for eligible borrowers.
  • FHA may begin at 3.5% for qualifying borrowers.
  • VA and USDA may offer no-down-payment financing when eligible.

Prepared buyer

  • Plans for closing costs and prepaid expenses.
  • Keeps money available for inspections, moving, and repairs.
  • Protects an emergency reserve after closing.
A smaller down payment can be a strategy—not a shortcut.
Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX

General guidelines only. Actual eligibility depends on full underwriting, credit, property, and lender overlays.
slides.speakerNotes:
Normalize low-down-payment options while stressing reserves and payment comfort. Down payment assistance may be available depending on income, location, and program; review repayment, pricing, or second-lien terms carefully.

Humor line: A 20% down payment is not a Hogwarts letter—you do not have to wait for it to arrive before asking questions.

[Sources]

slides.html:
Key three · Cash to close

Cash to close has four main ingredients.

1

Down payment

Your equity contribution.

2

Closing costs

Loan and transaction charges.

3

Prepaids + escrows

Ownership expenses funded ahead.

4

Credits + deposits

Amounts that reduce what remains due.

Earnest money is credited back into the calculation when properly documented.
Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX
slides.speakerNotes:
Define each category. Cash to close is estimated on the Loan Estimate and reconciled on the Closing Disclosure. Earnest money is not an extra charge if it is properly credited—it is money already paid toward the transaction.

Clarify that reserves are usually funds remaining after closing when required, not another closing charge.

[Sources]
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/loan-estimate/
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/closing-disclosure/
[/Sources]
slides.title: Cash to close has four main ingredients.

slides.html:
Key three · Cash to close

Closing costs

  • Origination and underwriting charges
  • Appraisal, title, and settlement services
  • Taxes and government recording fees
  • Optional discount points, when chosen

Prepaids + escrows

  • Prepaid interest through the end of the month
  • Homeowners insurance paid in advance
  • Initial property-tax and insurance escrow deposits
Different buckets. Both can affect cash to close.
Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX
slides.speakerNotes:
Explain the difference between transaction charges and amounts collected for immediate or future ownership expenses. Points are an upfront charge paid in exchange for a lower interest rate when that option is selected.

The Loan Estimate helps compare expected terms and costs. The Closing Disclosure shows the final transaction details before closing.

[Sources]
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/loan-estimate/
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/closing-disclosure/
[/Sources]

slides.html:
Affordability

Your payment is bigger than principal and interest.

Judge the all-in payment you will live with—not only the amount you can qualify for.

Principal
Interest
Taxes
Insurance
Mortgage insurance
HOA

What's locked

  • Principal and interest on a fixed-rate loan
  • Loan term

What can still move

  • Property taxes
  • Homeowners insurance
  • Mortgage insurance
  • HOA dues
  • Taxes, insurance, and HOA dues can change after closing.
  • Your comfortable payment may be lower than your maximum approval.
Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX
slides.speakerNotes:
Connect cash-to-close planning to the ongoing payment. Taxes, insurance, and HOA dues can change, so buyers should judge comfort rather than merely maximum approval.

Humor line: The underwriter can approve a payment; they cannot approve whether you still want tacos on Friday.

[Sources]
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/loan-estimate/
- https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/closing-disclosure/
[/Sources]
slides.title: Your payment is bigger than principal and interest.

slides.html:
After preapproval

Protect the version of you we approved.

Before making a financial change, call your lender first.

  • ✕Open new credit or co-sign for someone else.
  • ✕Buy or lease a vehicle.
  • ✕Finance furniture or appliances.
  • ✕Move large, unexplained deposits between accounts.
  • ✕Change jobs, pay off debt, or close accounts without checking first.
Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX
slides.speakerNotes:
Give quick examples: furniture financing, an auto purchase, cash deposits, a job change, or co-signing. None is automatically fatal, but each can change the information used to qualify the borrower and must be reviewed.

Suggested line: The lender does not hate sofas. The lender hates surprise monthly payments attached to sofas.
slides.title: Protect the version of you we approved.

slides.html:
Prepare

Bring the documents that tell your financial story.

01

Income

  • Paystubs
  • W-2s or tax returns
  • Employment history
02

Assets

  • Bank statements
  • Investment or retirement funds
  • Gift-fund details
03

Identity + property

  • Photo identification
  • Housing history
  • Purchase contract when available
Self-employment, variable income, gifts, and assistance may require additional documentation.
Mountain State Financial Group, LLC · NMLS# 1314257 · msfg.us
Licensed in CO, IN, MI, MN, ND, SD, TX
slides.speakerNotes:
Keep this high-level so it does not become a document lecture. Mention that self-employed borrowers, variable income, gifts, and down payment assistance may require additional documentation.

Humor line: Underwriting does not ask for documents because it is building a scrapbook. Every page answers a risk question.
slides.title: Bring the documents that tell your financial story.
